body.note: The PEFDPP paper derives 173 competency questions from Annex I of the PEF Recommendation and uses them to validate the ontology. This is a curated subset that runs live against the case study graph. Each one names the PEF requirement it comes from.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §4.2 — the functional unit shall specify what, how well, how much and how long.
questions.question: What is the functional unit, and how does it convert to a physical reference flow?
questions.why_it_matters: Two PEF studies can only be compared if their functional units match. Making the conversion machine-readable is what lets a downstream actor re-base the result.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §4.1 — the goal shall report intended application, audience, commissioner and whether the study is subject to verification.
questions.question: Who commissioned the study, who verified it, and for what decision context?
questions.why_it_matters: Verification is what makes a declared footprint trustworthy. If the verifier is a triple rather than a sentence in a PDF, a machine can check it.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §5.4 — the system boundary shall be described and any exclusion justified.
questions.question: What is the system boundary, what is excluded from it, and on what justification?
questions.why_it_matters: Most footprint disputes are boundary disputes. Structuring the exclusions makes them auditable instead of buried in prose.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §5.3 — results shall be reported per life cycle stage.
questions.question: Which activities make up the product system, and at which life cycle stage does each sit?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?stage ?activity ?geography WHERE {
  ?ps a prs:ProductSystem ; prs:hasActivityLink ?link .
  ?link prs:forActivity ?activity ; prs:hasLifeCycleStage ?stage .
  OPTIONAL { ?activity act:hasGeography ?geography }
} ORDER BY ?stage ?activity
questions.why_it_matters: The same unit process sits at a different stage in a different product system. PEFDPP puts the stage on the ActivityLink, not the Activity, so inventory stays reusable.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.1 / CFB-EV §5 — all manufacturing-stage processes shall be company-specific; non-most-relevant processes may use secondary datasets.
questions.question: Which datasets are company-specific and which are secondary, and are they EF-compliant?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?dataset ?title ?type ?compliance WHERE {
  ?dataset a dataset:LCIDataset .
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset dcterms:title ?title }
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset dataset:hasDatasetType ?type }
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset dataset:hasComplianceLevel ?compliance }
} ORDER BY ?dataset
questions.why_it_matters: This is the check a verifier runs first. It is a two-line query here.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.5 — DQR shall be calculated from technological, temporal and geographical representativeness and precision, and reported per dataset and per study.
questions.question: What is the data quality rating of each dataset, broken down by DQR dimension?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?dataset ?overallDQR ?dimension ?score ?justification WHERE {
  ?dataset a dataset:LCIDataset ; dq:hasDataQuality ?dqNode .
  ?dqNode dq:hasOverallDQR ?overallDQR ; dq:hasDQRCriterion ?crit .
  ?crit dq:forDimension ?dimension ; dq:hasValue ?score .
  OPTIONAL { ?crit dq:hasJustification ?justification }
} ORDER BY ?dataset ?dimension
questions.why_it_matters: A footprint without a DQR is a number without an error bar. The workbench weights each dataset's DQR by how much it actually contributes.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.5 — geographical representativeness shall be documented per dataset.
questions.question: Where does each activity take place?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?activity ?geography ?companySpecific WHERE {
  ?activity a act:Activity ; act:hasGeography ?geography .
  OPTIONAL { ?activity act:isCompanySpecific ?companySpecific }
} ORDER BY ?geography ?activity
questions.why_it_matters: This drives the electricity grid factor in the calculation. The engine reads the geography off the graph rather than asking a human to pick a grid.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6 — the inventory shall report all inputs and outputs per unit process.
questions.question: What goes into cell manufacturing, in what quantity, and in what unit?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?label ?flowType ?amount ?unit WHERE {
  ?flow act:inputOf ?activity ; flow:hasFlowType ?flowType ; flow:hasMeasure ?m .
  ?activity act:hasActivityType act:CellManufacturing .
  ?m om:hasNumericalValue ?amount ; om:hasUnit ?unit .
  OPTIONAL { ?flow flow:contextualLabel ?label }
} ORDER BY DESC(?amount)
questions.why_it_matters: This is the level of detail a declared footprint value cannot give you. It is what makes an assessment reproducible rather than merely verified.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.1 — the origin of every dataset used shall be documented.
questions.question: Which flows are sourced from a secondary background database rather than measured?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?flowType ?label ?sourceDataset WHERE {
  ?flowType flow:sourcedFrom ?sourceDataset .
  OPTIONAL { ?flowType rdfs:label ?label }
} ORDER BY ?sourceDataset ?flowType
questions.why_it_matters: This is the boundary between what the manufacturer knows and what it borrowed. It is exactly the set of flows the workbench has to proxy, and it is queryable.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.3 — elementary flows shall be taken from the EF reference package.
questions.question: Which elementary flows does the foreground emit directly, and which EF 3.1 flow is each one?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?activity ?label ?amount ?unit ?ef31Match WHERE {
  ?flow flow:hasFlowType ?ft ; flow:hasMeasure ?m .
  ?ft a flow:ElementaryFlow .
  OPTIONAL { ?flow act:outputOf ?activity }
  OPTIONAL { ?flow flow:contextualLabel ?label }
  OPTIONAL { ?ft skos:exactMatch ?ef31Match }
  ?m om:hasNumericalValue ?amount ; om:hasUnit ?unit .
}
questions.why_it_matters: Because each one carries its EF 3.1 UUID, characterisation is a machine join. No name matching, no spreadsheet lookup, no transcription error.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §7 — the CFF shall be applied and its parameters reported.
questions.question: What Circular Footprint Formula parameters are declared for the end-of-life flows?
questions.why_it_matters: The CFF decides who gets the recycling credit. Carrying R2, the virgin equivalent and the disposal route as triples means the split can be recomputed, not just believed.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.1 — company-specific data shall be used for processes under the company's control; supplier-specific data may be used where available.
questions.question: Which activities carry primary data contributed by an upstream actor rather than the battery maker?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?dataset ?title ?activity ?geography WHERE {
  ?dataset a dataset:LCIDataset ; dataset:hasDatasetType dataset:DPP ;
           dataset:containsActivity ?activity .
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset dcterms:title ?title }
  ?activity act:isCompanySpecific true .
  OPTIONAL { ?activity act:hasGeography ?geography }
} ORDER BY ?dataset
questions.why_it_matters: This is the DPP argument in one query. The brazing service sits below the PEF cut-off and would normally vanish into a background average — but its supplier measured it, so the passport carries the real number.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §6.2 / CFB-EV §7.4 — transport shall report distance, load factor and empty return share, or use the prescribed defaults.
questions.question: Which transport flows declare a distance, a loading rate and empty returns?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?label ?distance ?distanceUnit ?loadingRate ?emptyReturns WHERE {
  ?flow flow:transportDistance ?d .
  ?d om:hasNumericalValue ?distance ; om:hasUnit ?distanceUnit .
  OPTIONAL { ?flow flow:contextualLabel ?label }
  OPTIONAL { ?flow flow:transportLoadingRate ?loadingRate }
  OPTIONAL { ?flow flow:transportEmptyReturns ?emptyReturns }
}
questions.why_it_matters: Distribution is usually a footnote in a footprint report. Here the parameters are addressable, so a different distribution scenario is a re-query, not a re-study.

questions.pef_requirement: Derived from PEF Annex I §6.1 and the paper's reuse argument — Activity is modelled independently of PEFStudy precisely so it can be referenced by other studies.
questions.question: Which flow types are produced inside this value chain, so a downstream study could reuse them?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?flowType ?label ?activity ?geography WHERE {
  ?activity act:hasDeterminingFlow ?flow .
  ?flow flow:hasFlowType ?flowType .
  OPTIONAL { ?flowType rdfs:label ?label }
  OPTIONAL { ?activity act:hasGeography ?geography }
} ORDER BY ?flowType
questions.why_it_matters: This is the payoff of modelling Activity outside PEFStudy. Every row here is a unit process another manufacturer could cite instead of re-measuring.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §5.5 — all EF impact categories shall be included unless justified.
questions.question: Which impact categories are declared in scope, and which method calculates each one?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?impactCategory WHERE {
  ?scope a ps:Scope ; ps:includesImpactCategory ?impactCategory .
} ORDER BY ?impactCategory
questions.why_it_matters: The Battery Regulation only mandates climate change, but the PEF requires all 16. The scope declaration and the results can be cross-checked automatically.

questions.pef_requirement: PEF Annex I §4 — the applicable PEFCR or sector guidance shall be identified.
questions.question: Which methodological standard does the study declare conformity to?
questions.sparql:
PREFIX ps:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/pefstudy#>
PREFIX prs:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/product-system#>
PREFIX act:     <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/activity#>
PREFIX flow:    <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/flow#>
PREFIX dataset: <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataset#>
PREFIX dq:      <https://w3id.org/mintjesba/pefdpp/dataquality#>
PREFIX om:      <http://www.ontology-of-units-of-measure.org/resource/om-2/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs:    <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX foaf:    <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?standard ?title ?issued ?source WHERE {
  ?study a ps:PEFStudy ; dcterms:conformsTo ?standard .
  OPTIONAL { ?standard dcterms:title ?title }
  OPTIONAL { ?standard dcterms:issued ?issued }
  OPTIONAL { ?standard dcterms:source ?source }
}
questions.why_it_matters: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Article 7 requires the battery carbon footprint to follow PEF. Declaring the exact guidance document as a resolvable IRI is how that becomes checkable.
